name: Trenton–Mercer (TTN)
description: Preferred airport — 20 min from home. Frontier only to MCO (Thu/Fri/Mon evenings); Allegiant to Orlando Sanford (SFB) on Fri/Mon.

name: Philadelphia Intl (PHL)
description: Second choice (~1 hr drive). Frontier, American, Southwest, United to MCO; Frontier/American to TPA.

name: Newark Liberty (EWR)
description: Third choice (~1h15 drive). United, JetBlue, Frontier to MCO; United to TPA.

name: Orlando Intl (MCO)
description: Main Orlando airport, ~25–35 min to Walt Disney World.

name: Orlando Sanford Intl (SFB)
description: Allegiant's Orlando airport, ~45–55 min NE of Disney. Allegiant flies TTN↔SFB Fri + Mon.

name: Tampa Intl (TPA)
description: Alternate — ~75 mi / 1h20 drive to Disney via I-4. Often cheaper nonstops from PHL.
address: 4100 George J Bean Pkwy, Tampa, FL 33607

name: EPCOT
description: Friday park. MBG parade: band arrives 8:45 AM in uniform, step-off 10:05 AM in the UK pavilion, ends at the American Adventure. Then the World Showcase lap with Food & Wine Festival booths (festival runs Aug 27 – Nov 21). Multi Pass picks: Frozen Ever After, Remy, Soarin'.

name: Walt Disney World area (Lake Buena Vista)
description: Hotel area for the family. Band hotel TBD per Mr. Harding's flyer.

name: Nicole's — Land O' Lakes, FL
description: Nicole's house on Butterfly Kiss Dr, Land O' Lakes (north Tampa suburb, Pasco County). ~25 mi / 35 min to Tampa airport (TPA); ~95 mi / 1h40–2h to Epcot via I-75 → I-4 (longer than from Tampa proper). Free lodging Wed + Sun (Family Plan) or Wed + Sat (Nicole's Weekend).
address: Butterfly Kiss Dr, Land O' Lakes, FL 34638

name: Magic Kingdom
description: Thursday park. Classic first-visit rides; longest hours; Happily Ever After fireworks ~8–9 PM. Multi Pass picks: Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Jungle Cruise, Peter Pan's Flight.
address: 1180 Seven Seas Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830

name: Disney's Hollywood Studios
description: Saturday park — Star Wars (Galaxy's Edge), Toy Story Land, Frozen Sing-Along. Rope-drop day. Multi Pass: Slinky Dog Dash, Toy Story Mania, Runaway Railway; Single Pass: Rise of the Resistance.
address: 351 S Studio Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830

name: Disney's Animal Kingdom
description: Disney theme park — safari, Pandora, Festival of the Lion King.

name: Universal Orlando Resort
description: Universal Studios Florida + Islands of Adventure (Hogsmeade & Diagon Alley).

name: Hyatt Place Orlando Airport
description: Sushant's family, night of Nov 6 (not the Hyatt inside MCO).

name: Holiday Inn Orlando – Disney Springs Area (IHG)
description: Our hotel Thu–Sat (pending booking confirmation). Walk to Disney Springs; ~10–15 min drive to Epcot / Magic Kingdom.
address: 1805 Hotel Plaza Blvd, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
